in_arabic.name: Mahsunah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Mahsunah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'h-s-n' meaning 'to make perfect, to adorn', Mahsunah represents the concept of completeness and perfection in Islam. In the Quran, Allah (swt) says, 'Indeed, Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves.' (13:11), emphasizing the importance of personal growth and self-improvement towards attaining spiritual perfection.
